  "required_fixes": [
    "R1 — Preserve the file-list bound after successful uploads. authority/gateway_files_domain.rs:440-445 inserts each created file into the cached list without enforcing MAX_FILES or updating more. Reading 200 files and uploading one new file therefore produces 201 rows, while desktop-contracts/src/client.ts:876 accepts at most 200. An independent in-memory contract probe accepted the 200-row snapshot and rejected the exact post-insertion 201-row shape with ContractViolation('shell snapshot'). The upload can succeed remotely while its settled snapshot is rejected, leaving the presentation on stale state and reporting an unexpected update. Acceptance: every list mutation must preserve the bounded wire contract and truthful coverage, including uploads into full/already-truncated lists and repeated uploads. Keep the new file/result usable, report any omitted files, and verify the actual Core upload-to-snapshot path and App observation path at the boundary.",
    "R2 — Match a delete response to the requested file before claiming success or refusal. gateway_files.rs:253-257 discards GatewayInferenceDeleteFileResponse.id and keeps only deleted; :290-292 then treats true as Completed and false as Rejected. sync_files subsequently removes the requested ID on Completed and the UI says that file was deleted. The pinned SDK validates the response's shape but does not compare its ID with the request. A successful-shaped reply naming file-B to DELETE file-A therefore falsely resolves A's outcome. Acceptance: require the returned identity to match the admitted target. A mismatched identity must remain an invalid/uncertain result for the sent mutation, retain the requested file's recovery record and trace, preserve uncertainty in the cached list, and never replay. Add literal external-response fixtures for mismatched IDs with deleted=true and deleted=false, alongside matching success/refusal.",
    "R3 — Handle unrenderable file timestamps without throwing. gateway_files.rs:57-70 accepts created_at up to 9e15 seconds, and the presentation contract accepts a nonnegative safe integer. gateway-files.tsx:22,173 unconditionally calls Date(...).toISOString(), whose representable range is smaller. In an independent source-executing render, createdAt=9000000000000 passed parseShellSnapshot but FilesPanel threw RangeError: Invalid time value. This integer also meets the pinned SDK schema's finite/integer checks. Acceptance: validate/project the timestamp into a renderable range or display an explicit nonfatal invalid/unknown time. An out-of-range remote timestamp must not prevent using the Files view or shell. Cover ordinary timestamps and the out-of-range case through the projection/contract and production component."
  ],
  "blockers": [],
  "evidence_gaps": [
    "G1 — The new file suites do not establish the boundaries in R1-R3. The integration success path begins with one seed file and the delete fixture always echoes the target; file metadata fixtures use ordinary timestamps. The read-only list-cap unit case does not cover uploads mutating a full cache. Add causal Core/contract/App cases for the identified failures and refresh relevant native/error-state evidence against the resulting frozen source. Current passing counts and mutation probes do not close these cases."
  ],
  "optional_suggestions": [],
  "limitations": [
    "All four supplied fingerprints recompute exactly. Verified 605 source-inventory entries, 322 referenced hashes, command logs/artifacts, before/after inputs, exact intended command sequences and the passing C17 predecessor receipt/request/verdict/raw-output bindings.",
    "Attempt-02 R1, R2 and G1 are addressed: D045 corrects the SDK assessment and defines an implemented file subset; incomplete Responses/chat answers have an explicit state, visible reason and retained partial output. Inspected integration/App/native cases distinguish completed, incomplete and failed answers. An independent in-memory render confirmed incomplete text and max_output_tokens without a false Completed label. Attempt-01's earlier fixes remain present.",
    "The new file modules reuse native-owned selection, the workspace/key admission check, bounded operations and the existing tenant-local recovery store. Inspected upload bytes/purpose, attachment admission, credential/workspace withdrawal, uncertainty records and no-replay tests. No new dependency, SDK feature or shipped JavaScript backend was introduced.",
    "Supplied logs report 382 desktop tests, 178 core library tests, 15 Gateway inference integration tests, 143 scoped frontend/contract tests and passing Gateway change/read, credential and IPC regressions. All 41 mutation probes report named guard failures; 12 input source hashes match, and four baseline targets passed three times each. These are inspected implementer-run results, not independently rerun application tests.",
    "The 13 C18 native checks and C01-C17 regression records report pass against fixture executable 332b97c68b3e53d421da8cfa4a03e374928a8abd949e9dc04da509c043f85f28. Inspected the driver, observations and relevant Accessibility trees, including incomplete/failed answers, upload/delete confirmation, uncertain file records and offline editing. Native checks were not independently rerun. Upload selection uses the fixture picker; the production native sheet adapter was inspected. Spoken VoiceOver output is not recorded.",
    "The original T20 registration hash remains 2fbd7a9fd0010d702206afc839ea09700aac2673a85417d01956f8f76d8fb362. Acceptance samples recompute within its limits: first output p95 46.920 ms, 64 KiB completion p95 32.198 ms, stop p95 37.322 ms, responsiveness p95 23.324 ms, charts p95 117.374 ms and maximum process-tree RSS 430.2 MiB. These are synthetic stream/chart measurements; they do not independently qualify upload performance.",
    "Independent probes executed the production TypeScript contract and React components entirely in memory with presentation/native-boundary stubs. The cache probe modeled the exact inspected Rust insertion; it did not execute the Core upload operation. Delete-response identity findings follow from inspected application/SDK source, not a new network reproduction. The inspected SDK sources match the published crate archive and Cargo.lock checksum.",
    "Service evidence remains synthetic; live qualification is C25 and signed installed-package qualification C26. This chunk review does not establish cumulative P05 completion or supersede its separate chunk/phase gates.",
    "No application source was changed, product endpoints called or credentials accessed. No application build or on-disk application test was run for this review. Only the designated verdict artifact was written."
  ],
